changes.title: Justice Department expands military's power to detain migrants accused of trespassing
changes.summary: The Justice Department issued a legal opinion giving the U.S. military broader powers to detain migrants near certain areas along the southern border.

changes.title: U.S. retail sales unexpectedly post largest drop in more than a year
changes.summary: The drop in spending raised concern among some economists about the resiliency of consumers who have powered the economy forward despite nagging inflation and soaring gasoline prices.

changes.title: USS Washington aircraft carrier heads to Middle East to replace USS Lincoln
changes.summary: The USS George Washington aircraft carrier departed Vietnam last week and is headed to the Middle East to replace the USS Abraham Lincoln, according to a U.S. official.

changes.title: Trump says he will soon declare the Strait of Hormuz a U.S. territory
changes.summary: The war in Iran continues on as Vice President Vance says the new goal is to keep costs down for Americans and President Trump disputes reports about mental health issues on deployed ships. NBC’s Monica Alba, Keir Simmons and Gordon Lubold bring their latest reporting on the war to the table.

changes.title: Trump Dismisses Reports About Dire Conditions Aboard U.S.S. Abraham Lincoln
changes.summary: Asked whether the deployment of the Abraham Lincoln had gone on too long, the president said its deployment had lasted “not nearly long enough.”.
